create.name: Kristi Kuttner
create.bio:
Kristi Kuttner is a San Diego teacher of yin yoga, yoga nidra and Reiki, registered with Yoga Alliance at E-RYT 500 level. She trained with Uplifted Yoga, where she now works as a lead support trainer on its 500-hour course, and later studied integrative healing at the Tranquility school in Encino. Time at the Clairvoyance Center of Hawaii, certification in Radiance Sutras Instinctive Meditation and training in Yinki, which blends yin yoga with Reiki and sound, also shape how she teaches. She describes herself as a highly sensitive person who has worked with energy for most of her life.

Each Wednesday she leads a midday yin class with Reiki and sound at Trilogy Sanctuary in La Jolla, and with fellow teacher Kelli Martin she runs Reiki Level 1 and 2 certifications there in the Usui Shiki Ryoho lineage. She also mentors new Reiki Master Teachers, gives Reiki sessions in person and at a distance, and offers a 70-hour online training in yin yoga, yoga nidra and sound that is accredited with Yoga Alliance. Her classes favour long supported holds, deep rest and attention to the moon and the seasons. Her YouTube channel and Insight Timer profile carry dozens of free yoga nidra practices, many arranged around the chakras.

courses.title: Liberated Rest: Yoga Nidra, Yin Yoga and Sacred Sound Training
courses.description: A 70-hour online certification, accredited with Yoga Alliance, for teaching yin yoga, yoga nidra and sound together. It includes manuals, live calls with replays and lifetime access to modules on philosophy, the koshas, the meridians, voice and script writing, and recording your own practices.

courses.title: Reiki Level 1 and 2 Certification
courses.description: One-day trainings in the Usui Shiki Ryoho lineage, taught with Kelli Martin at Trilogy Sanctuary in La Jolla, or privately in person or online. Level 1 covers the history and principles of Reiki, attunements and self-treatment; Level 2 adds the symbols, distance work and full sessions for others.

courses.title: Reiki Master Teacher Mentorship
courses.description: A mentorship for Reiki practitioners ready to teach, with the master attunement and symbol, a private one-to-one session and a seat in a live training to see how one is run. It also covers writing a manual and setting up your own classes.

courses.title: Weekly Yin Yoga with Reiki and Sound at Trilogy Sanctuary
courses.description: A Wednesday midday yin class in La Jolla where long, supported poses are accompanied by Reiki and live sound. Booking is through the studio.

courses.title: Reiki Sessions and Private Classes
courses.description: Full Reiki sessions in San Diego or at a distance, each opening with an intention and working through the chakras, plus private classes that combine yoga, meditation, sound and Reiki. In-person Reiki is booked up until January 2027; distance sessions are open.
courses.price: $111 USD (60-minute distance Reiki); $180 USD (90-minute private class); $222 USD (90-minute in-person Reiki)

free_resources.title: Kristi Kuttner on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Yoga nidra practices, many themed on the chakras, along with Reiki sessions, sound, breathwork and loving-kindness meditations. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra with Reiki: A Practice of Deep Rest
free_resources.description: A free guided yoga nidra blended with Reiki, sent by email when you join her mailing list. It is a gentle way to try her style of rest practice.
